voice: Plain and matter-of-fact, built around family ownership and decades of steady service rather than sales pressure. Talks about tires the way a shop counter would: rotation, balancing, repair, disposal, no hype.
headline: Folsom's Family Tire Shop for 60 Years
subhead: Sangillo Tire Center is family owned and operated, selling and servicing most major tire brands for cars and light trucks in Folsom, PA.
intro: Sangillo Tire Center has been serving the Delaware Valley for more than 60 years, selling and repairing tires for cars and light trucks out of Folsom. Family owned and operated, the shop carries most major tire brands and can usually get a size that isn't on hand within 24 hours. Every purchase includes free tire disposal, and every visit includes a check for damage, proper inflation, tire rotation, and wheel balancing. In many cases the shop can repair a tire instead of selling a replacement.

services.title: Tire Sales
services.blurb: Sangillo's sells most major brands of tires for automobiles and light trucks, including Michelin, Bridgestone, Firestone, Goodyear, Cooper, Continental, Pirelli, General, Kelly, and Dunlop. If a size isn't in stock, they can normally get it within 24 hours.

services.title: Tire Rotation
services.blurb: Rotating tires on a regular basis saves money through more mileage and fewer replacements, and helps fuel economy and treadwear. Staff check for damage and proper inflation at every rotation.

services.title: Tire Repair
services.blurb: In many cases Sangillo's is able to repair a tire instead of replacing it. The shop inspects for punctures, cracks, and uneven wear first.

services.title: Wheel Balancing
services.blurb: Every tire purchase includes balancing on state-of-the-art computer balancing machines. Improperly balanced tires cause vibration that increases with speed.

services.title: Tire Alignment Checks
services.blurb: The shop watches for signs that a vehicle's front and rear suspension is out of alignment, since misalignment wears tires unevenly and can affect handling.

services.title: Free Tire Disposal
services.blurb: Every tire purchase comes with free disposal of the old tire. Sangillo's recycles its scrap tires rather than sending them to landfill.

process.title: Tell us what's wrong
process.blurb: Call or stop by with the make, model, and what you're noticing, from a slow leak to uneven wear.

process.title: We check the tire
process.blurb: Staff inspect for punctures, cracks, bulges, and uneven treadwear before recommending a repair or a replacement.

process.title: We do the work
process.blurb: Rotation, balancing, repair, or new tires from most major brands, sized and matched to your car or light truck.

process.title: You drive off checked
process.blurb: Every visit includes a check for proper inflation, and every purchase includes computer balancing and free disposal of the old tire.

about: Sangillo Tire Center is a family owned and operated tire shop on MacDade Blvd in Folsom, serving the Delaware Valley for more than 60 years. The shop sells most major tire brands, including Michelin, Bridgestone, Firestone, Goodyear, Cooper, Continental, Pirelli, General, Kelly, and Dunlop, and can usually source a size that isn't in stock within 24 hours. Every rotation includes a check for tire damage and proper inflation, and every purchase includes computer wheel balancing plus free disposal. In many cases the team can repair a tire instead of selling a new one, and scrap tires are recycled rather than landfilled. Staff also watch for signs of poor alignment, since it wears tires unevenly. The shop is open Monday through Friday 8:00 to 5:00 and Saturday mornings until noon, closed Sundays.

faq.q: What tire brands does Sangillo's carry?
faq.a: Most major brands for cars and light trucks, including Michelin, Bridgestone, Firestone, Goodyear, Cooper, Continental, Pirelli, General, Kelly, and Dunlop. If a specific size isn't in stock, Sangillo's can normally get it within 24 hours.

faq.q: Do you repair tires or only replace them?
faq.a: In many cases they are able to repair a tire instead of replacing it, after checking for punctures, cracks, or uneven wear.

faq.q: How often should I get my tires rotated?
faq.a: According to your vehicle's manual. Regular rotation extends tire life, saves money on mileage, and helps fuel economy.
